title: In This World You Hear One Stranger's Heartbeat
description: Everyone hears exactly one other person's heartbeat, and Kenta has never known whose he hears. Whose heartbeat do you think you'd hear? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Kenta: 17-year-old Japanese boy, short spiky black hair, sleepy eyes, black gakuran school uniform jacket open over a grey hoodie, black trousers, white sneakers, black canvas backpack, no hat, no glasses
characters.Grandma Setsuko: 78-year-old Japanese woman, short curly white hair, small round face with deep smile lines, lavender knitted cardigan over a cream blouse, dark brown long skirt, beige house slippers, no glasses, no hat
characters.Mom: 45-year-old Japanese woman, black hair tied in a low bun, light blue blouse, white apron, grey slacks, no hat, no glasses

scenes.say: In this world, everyone hears exactly one other person's heartbeat. Nobody ever knows whose. Kenta is seventeen, and the one he hears has always been slow and calm.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In a small 1990s Japanese bedroom with tatami floor and a futon, Kenta lies awake in the dark, one hand resting on his own chest, listening. [4-7s] Close-up of Kenta's sleepy face on his pillow, eyes half closed, faint moonlight from the window. [7-10s] Medium shot of Kenta at a quiet empty country train platform at dawn, earphones off, tilting his head as if hearing something far away.

scenes.say: Except every Sunday at seven, it speeds up. That's when his grandma calls from her village, three hours away. Kenta usually says he's busy and hangs up.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In a small Japanese apartment kitchen at night, a beige corded wall phone rings while Mom holds out the receiver to Kenta. [4-7s] Medium shot of Kenta leaning on the kitchen wall with the receiver, rolling his eyes, mouthing a short goodbye. [7-10s] Close-up of Kenta hanging up the beige phone in the kitchen, then pausing, hand on his chest, frowning slightly.

scenes.say: So one Sunday he tests it. He lets it ring. The heartbeat climbs faster with every ring, then slows down, sad and heavy, when the ringing stops.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the apartment kitchen at night, the beige wall phone rings while Kenta stands frozen across the room, staring at it. [4-7s] Close-up of Kenta's hand pressed against his chest as the phone keeps ringing beside him. [7-10s] Medium shot of the silent phone on the kitchen wall, Kenta slowly sitting down at the small wooden table, guilty.

scenes.say: Then one Tuesday night, the heartbeat stumbles. It skips, then goes faint. Kenta doesn't call anyone. He grabs his bag and runs for the last train.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the dark tatami bedroom, Kenta sits bolt upright on his futon, eyes wide, clutching his chest. [4-7s] Medium shot of Kenta pulling on his sneakers in the narrow apartment entrance hallway while Mom calls after him from the doorway. [7-10s] Inside a nearly empty late-night local train carriage with green seats, Kenta sits alone by the dark window, knee bouncing.

scenes.say: Three hours later he bursts into her little wooden house. Grandma's on the floor by the stove. She slipped and twisted her ankle. She's fine, just stuck.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Kenta slides open the front door of a small old wooden village house at night, out of breath. [4-7s] Medium shot inside the house's dim kitchen with an old iron stove: Grandma Setsuko sits on the wooden floor holding her ankle, looking up in shock. [7-10s] Close-up of Kenta kneeling and gently wrapping her ankle with a cloth while she pats his cheek.

scenes.say: She laughs. "I hear a heartbeat too, you know. It raced for three hours tonight." In this world, you hear one other heartbeat. Theirs have been listening to each other.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the small wooden village house kitchen, Grandma Setsuko laughs and presses her hand on Kenta's chest. [4-7s] Close-up of Kenta's face, eyes going wet, then breaking into an embarrassed smile. [7-10s] Wide quiet shot of Kenta and Grandma Setsuko sitting side by side on the wooden step of the little house's porch at dawn, sharing a cup of tea, mountains in mist behind them.
